# Candidates hardcoded from SQL query result
# Run this in SSMS first:
# SELECT event_id, company_id FROM dbo.FACT_Events
# WHERE event_status = 'cancelled' AND cancellation_reason IS NULL
# ORDER BY company_id
# Then paste the results as a list below, or use the ADLS approach in Block 2

print(f"✓ {len(API_KEYS)} API keys loaded")

# Block 2: Read candidates from ADLS via Spark
# Much simpler than JDBC — reads directly from the gold layer parquet
candidates_df = spark.read \
    .format("jdbc") \
    .option("url", "jdbc:sqlserver://dudodataserver1.database.windows.net:1433;database=dudodatabase1;encrypt=true;trustServerCertificate=false;hostNameInCertificate=*.database.windows.net;loginTimeout=30;Authentication=ActiveDirectoryManagedIdentity") \
    .option("query", "SELECT event_id, company_id FROM dbo.FACT_Events WHERE event_status = 'cancelled' AND cancellation_reason IS NULL") \
    .option("driver", "com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver") \
    .load()

candidates = candidates_df.collect()
print(f"✓ {len(candidates)} candidates")

# Block 4: Save results to ADLS as CSV — update via SSMS daarna
import csv, io

OUTPUT_PATH = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/stagingMICE/backfill/cancellation_reasons.csv"

if not results:
    print("ℹ️ No results")
else:
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("event_id", LongType(), False),
        StructField("cancellation_reason", StringType(), True),
        StructField("cancellation_note", StringType(), True)
    ])

    results_df = spark.createDataFrame(results, schema=schema)
    results_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(OUTPUT_PATH)

    print(f"✓ {len(results)} rows saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
    print("\nDownload de CSV en voer in SSMS uit:")
    print("""
-- Na importeren als tabel dbo.BackfillCancellationReasons:
UPDATE e
SET e.cancellation_reason = s.cancellation_reason,
    e.cancellation_note   = s.cancellation_note
FROM dbo.FACT_Events e
INNER JOIN dbo.BackfillCancellationReasons s ON e.event_id = s.event_id
WHERE s.cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL;
